_doc: #1499 The Cost page. `usage` is the SAME source the Cloud SuperApp Notify AI badge reads: the usage table c3 publishes (GET /ai/usage of cloudy-c3-api; c3-infra-api is its alias for one release; the ai-usage hook posts to POST /ai/usage/claude there), read through libs:ai-usage's AiUsageClient (the route is AiUsageClient.PATH, not spelled here). `bases` are tried in order; the fleet bearer is read at runtime from Cloud Account's secret provider under `bearer_key` and never stored. Claude windows come from the table's `claude` block; OpenRouter spend and balance from its `openrouter` block (fetched server side by the API from the OpenRouter key, which stays in the private store). `sample_openrouter` is shown, labelled sample, only when the table has no configured OpenRouter block. Metrics: five_hour, seven_day, week_left, week_est (Claude); last_24h, last_7d, month, balance, est_30d (OpenRouter, est_30d = last_7d / 7 * 30); none.
